verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a REST API for faults (issues) with list/single-fault retrieval and search-style querying (docs-19, docs-4), plus a reporting API for creating notices, but there is no evidence of an update-issue endpoint, a raw-events fetch endpoint, or explicit scoped-token support (only a generic API key/Honeybadger-Token is mentioned). missing for 10: documented issue-update endpoint, raw event retrieval endpoint, explicit scoped/read-only token documentation.
